_comment: THE FLEET REGISTRY. Copy to projects.json (same dir) and add one entry per project.
THE SIX THINGS THE DAEMON NEEDS PER PROJECT:
id            the stable key AND the AO project name the sync filters on
root          the repo's ABSOLUTE root (where gates/ + .githooks/ + .github/ live)
tokenEnv      the NAME of the env var holding the credential -- NEVER the bytes
worktreeRoot  where that repo's per-session git worktrees live (absolute)
store         the per-project SQLite path (absolute). ONE STORE PER PROJECT:
SQLite has one writer, so N projects on one file would contend
(SQLITE_BUSY) and share a crash domain. Per-project stores give
write isolation, failure isolation, and make the
A BAD ENTRY IS NAMED AND SKIPPED -- it never takes the daemon down and never
takes the other projects with it. `upper projects` lists what loaded and what did not.
ARM ITS RULESET:    upper arm <id>        (AFTER the workflows have run once)
